reuse.why: Replaces the three identical copies of the average actions' category query, and setZero's unfiltered query, with one getMonthWideCategories function that copyPreviousMonth also uses; the pre-existing per-action income/tracking check is left as it was rather than folded in.

duplication.why: Net removal of duplication: three pasted SQL blocks collapse into one function and the hidden check is removed from copyPreviousMonth; no new copies are added.

placement.why: The selection rule sits in budget/actions.ts beside getBudgetData, where the month-wide actions that consume it live.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the now-unused hidden fields of BudgetData, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Changing which categories month-wide actions skip is now a one-query edit with a comment saying what it means; copyPreviousMonth pays an extra query to build an id set, and the income/tracking rule still repeats at each action.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) takes its category set from getMonthWideCategories

disguised_duplication.where: The old copies were deleted and replaced by calls

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden, hidden-group and saved-template exclusion, and all five month-wide actions use it
